mission.title: containerd: pkg/oci/spec_opts.go needs updating with latest opencontainers/runtme-spec
mission.description: pkg/oci/spec_opts.go needs updating with latest opencontainers/runtme-spec. This issue affects 8+ users.

steps.title: Identify containerd troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your containerd deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n containerd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=containerd
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=containerd -n containerd --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review containerd configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant containerd configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n containerd -l app.kubernetes.io/name=containerd
kubectl get configmap -n containerd -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=containerd
```
In https://github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/commit/869b2d5b0c9fbb9db559ab53cf1fa61a170835e9, the schema for LinuxPid was changed, so that Limit is now a `*int64` rather than just an `int64`.

steps.title: Apply the fix for pkg/oci/spec_opts.go needs updating with latest…
steps.description:
I see this has been fixed for the `containerd/containerd/v2` releases, but not when importing `github.com/containerd/containerd` as a library (which one of my dependencies does).  Would a backport of the fix to the `release-1.7` branch (and then a 1.7.31 release) be accepted?
```yaml
../../../go/1.24.10/pkg/mod/github.com/containerd/containerd/v2@v2.2.0/pkg/oci/spec_opts.go:1604:34: cannot use limit (variable of type int64) as *int64 value in assignment
```

steps.title: Confirm pkg/oci/spec_opts.go needs updating with latest… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=containerd -n containerd --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n containerd --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary: I see this has been fixed for the `containerd/containerd/v2` releases, but not when importing `github.com/containerd/containerd` as a library (which one of my dependencies does).  Would a backport of the fix to the `release-1.7` branch (and then a 1.7.31 release) be accepted?

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with containerd installed or the issue environment reproducible.
